task: Write acceptance tests for DAEO-kl5e (W2-50) covering the last review's two findings (DEC-751), and rewrite the earlier cases that conflict with them (DEC-491).
status: DONE — 25 new cases are committed; 15 fail today for the reasons stated in the README and 10 are controls that pass. All 208 earlier cases pass, the 80 rewritten ones included. W1-15 passes in full.
work_completed: Added `test_w2_50_last_review.py` with 25 cases. Added one public helper, `open_own_folder`, to the support module; it makes a ticket's folder by running `gov launch` with the suite's stand-in CLI. Rewrote the setup of 80 earlier cases so the own folder is made by a launch. No expectation changed. Updated the README: the new tests mapped to each behaviour with its red reason, every rewrite with its reason, and the case count, now 233 in 8 files. Behaviour 1 (a folder belongs to the one repository whose launch made it) has these tests:
  - Controls, passing now: `test_the_launching_repositorys_session_keeps_its_folder`, `test_a_later_launch_in_the_same_repository_keeps_the_folder_its_content_and_its_entry` and `test_a_second_worktree_of_the_same_repository_gets_the_same_folder` (made with `git worktree add` of the temporary repository).
  - `test_another_repositorys_session_gets_nothing_in_a_folder_the_first_made` and `test_a_launch_in_another_repository_neither_adds_nor_changes_the_folder` (3 forms each): (a) a project built separately outside the root, ticket W2-91; (b) a clone inside `~/gov-os-runs/W2-90/clone`, ticket W2-91; (c) a clone outside the root, ticket W2-90. Each guard case also checks that the first project's session still keeps the folder.
  - `test_a_folder_made_by_hand_gives_no_session_anything` and `test_a_folder_that_does_not_exist_yet_gives_no_session_anything`, each run before any launch and beside a launched folder.
  - `test_a_launch_neither_adds_nor_records_a_folder_that_exists_without_a_record`, with an empty folder and one holding a file.
  - No case writes, names or reads the record. Where a case checks that a folder did not change, it compares entries by name, kind, size and modification time without opening any file (DEC-462).
  Behaviour 2 (a project's own secrets check follows a link that stays inside the project, also under the root) has these tests:
  - `test_a_projects_own_check_follows_a_link_that_stays_inside_the_project`: 2 locations × 3 links. The links are a store-folder link, a folder link in `scratch/` and a file link. Each case first checks that the check is green with no link.
  - Controls: `test_a_link_under_the_root_but_outside_the_project_is_still_not_followed` (a sibling in the same own folder, another ticket's folder, the root itself) and `test_this_repositorys_check_does_not_follow_a_link_into_a_clone_under_the_root`.

  - Red reasons as seen at `21ac28b7`:
    - Another repository's guard calls (3): "Write on …/gov-os-runs/W2-91/work/README.md by the engineer on DAEO-zz91 of another repository …/gov-os-runs/W2-90/clone (a-clone-inside-the-first-projects-own-folder) was not refused: decision=allow". The other two forms fail the same way.
    - Another repository's launch (3): "the sandbox of a session on DAEO-zz90 in another repository …/clones/third (…) may write at or under the root through ['//…/gov-os-runs/W2-90']".
    - Folder made by hand (2): "Write on …/gov-os-runs/W2-90/work/README.md (a folder made by hand, before-any-launch) was not refused: decision=allow".
    - Folder not made yet (2): "Write on …/gov-os-runs/W2-90/notes.txt (the own folder does not exist yet, …) was not refused".
    - Launch into a folder that has no record (2): "the launch added a folder that no launch made (empty) through ['//…/gov-os-runs/W2-90']".
    - Secrets check in the clone under the root (3): "the check of the project …/gov-os-runs/W2-90/clone (a-clone-under-the-root) did not follow a-store-folder-link .gov-runtime/packets -> …/clone/shared-store, a place of the same project that holds a secret: it is green".
tests: W2-50, the whole suite run to its end at `21ac28b7` plus these changes: **15 failed, 218 passed, 0 skipped** (233 cases, about 3 minutes). All 15 failures are in the new file; the 208 earlier cases pass. W1-15, run to its end: **124 passed**.
discoveries: (1) Under DEC-751, R2's guard half is gone. R2 let a session that was not launched (the orchestrator) create the folder with its first write. Now it can write there only after a launch of that ticket has made the folder. (2) The record lies in a folder the ticket's own session may write. That session can remove or change it and so close its own folder, but it cannot open another repository's. No source says the record is protected; not tested. (3) The secrets check scans only `.gov-runtime/`: with no link, a secret elsewhere in the project leaves it green. Each new secrets case checks this before adding the link.
risks: (1) The "changes nothing" checks compare modification times. A launcher that rewrites the record with the same bytes during another repository's launch turns them red; that is intended, since DEC-751 says that launch must not change the record. (2) The 39 rewritten refusal cases in `test_w2_50_guard_refusals.py` now launch MAIN and OTHER first. If the record rule refused the fixture project's own folder by mistake, those cases would still pass; the allowance cases in `test_w2_50_guard_own_folder.py` and the controls in the new file would catch it. (3) The suite's run time rose from about 1.5 to about 3 minutes because of the extra launches.
lessons: Make an own folder only with `support.open_own_folder` (or `gov launch`) before the first plan is set on the stand-in CLI, because the stand-in carries out any plan that is present. For "another repository", use a `git clone` or a project built from scratch inside the test's temporary folder; a `git worktree add` is the same repository.
proposed_decisions: none
unresolved: Whether the orchestrator, which is not launched, should have a way to make a ticket's folder without a launch (discovery 1). This is for the lead to put to the owner if it matters.
recommended_next_action: The engineer implements DEC-751 P-A (a) and P-B (a) until `tests/acceptance/W2-50` is all green (233) and W1-15 stays green (124).
